text:
jamie: quick sync - we've had multiple automatic fallbacks during quota spikes and the on-call can't tell which ones are safe to undo. need a safer operator flow.

lucas: +1. idea: "preview undo" that runs a fast simulation against sampled traffic and returns estimated deltas (error rate, p95 latency, token cost). small UX panel, not full replay.

priya: must be auditable. any manual undo should create an immutable override record containing who did it, reason code, preview id, and telemetry snapshot. retention policy: 90d default, 1y for incidents.

jamie: agreed. sketch API:

POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/undo-preview
{ "sample_pct": 5, "preview_seconds": 30 }

Response: plain text summary and a preview_id.

POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/apply-undo
{ "preview_id": "abc123", "reason_code": "operator:temp_bump", "ttl_seconds": 600 }

lucas: server-side rules: block apply-undo if (current_error - baseline) > 0.05 OR latency_increase_pct > 30. also enforce max ttl 3600s and max 1 active undo per route.

priya: security: role rollout:operator required to apply, rollout:viewer can see preview. make sure preview results are not surfaced to public customer dashboards.

jamie: UX: show top 3 error classes and 3 anonymized request samples in the preview accordion. add a one-click "create incident" link that seeds an ops ticket with the preview and audit link.

lucas: telemetry: attach trace ids, error histograms, and before/after metrics snapshot to the audit record. also emit a machine-readable fallback_reason on every fallback event so automation can cluster and filter.

ops-bot: CI pipeline queued: undo-preview-feature/tests -> staging

priya: operational concern: previews cost CPU. limit heavy previews to opt-in tenants and throttle at 1 preview per-minute per-route. fallback events should still be sampled at ingest to build models.

jamie: experiments: roll out preview to 10% of routes and track two metrics: time-to-recover (ops action latency) and false-positive rollbacks (rollbacks that increase errors).

lucas: next steps: jamie will mock the panel, priya write audit schema + IAM rules, i'll spec the preview runner and limits. i'll also add SDK stubs and docs.

priya: filed ticket: OPS-4430 (preview undo + operator override audit). i'll post schema by EOD.

jamie: thanks all, i'll drop a quick figma and a short A/B plan.
